description: Abstract class for console commands in the Goteo project, providing logging, input/output handling, and event dispatching functionalities.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract class extending Symfony's Command, adding logging and event dispatching capabilities for Goteo console commands.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the InputInterface object for the command.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the OutputInterface object for the command.

methods.name: addLogger
methods.description: Adds a Logger instance to the command's logs.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a cached Logger instance by name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with context, outputting to console if available, and passing to the logger.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event via the Console class.
